title: Named the most influential Technical Experts Council member in India
summary: At IBM's 2010 Regional Technical Leadership Exchange, I was recognized as the most influential member of the India Technical Experts Council, three years into my career.
the_call: Invest in the lab's technical community, not only my product.
what_i_did: Contributed to the India Technical Experts Council through events, sessions and the technical leadership exchange agenda.
what_changed: Award from the Regional Technical Leadership Exchange, signed by IBM India's chief technologist.

images.alt: Certificate: Named the most influential Technical Experts Council member in India
